articles.title: White House adviser defends President Trump's crypto ties in wake of Clarity Act defeat
articles.snippet: President Donald Trump's crypto adviser, Patrick Witt, accused Democrats of unfairly amplifying Trump's crypto ties as a political weapon.

articles.title: Zcash leads crypto majors with a 10% gain as bitcoin holds near $87,000
articles.snippet: Falling oil eased inflation worries through the Asian session, while a bill to make the government's bitcoin stockpile permanent moved further through Congress than any before it.

articles.title: US lawmakers from gaming states urge SCOTUS to take up Kalshi case
articles.snippet: The case between New Jersey authorities and a prediction market company, if accepted by the Supreme Court, could result in clarity for state and federal officials over sports bets.

articles.title: Winners and losers of the SEC’s new tokenized stocks rules
articles.snippet: The SEC has opened a five-year path for tokenized stocks, but only some products and venues fit the model. Will Uniswap, Robinhood, Coinbase or Kraken come out on top?

articles.title: EU watchdogs warn quantum computers could pick crypto’s locks
articles.snippet: EU supervisors warn quantum computing could weaken blockchain security as Bitcoin developers weigh a draft migration plan and Ethereum targets 2029.
